rules.name: Invoke-Expression / iex
rules.description: Dynamic string execution — unsanitized input leads to command injection.
rules.remediation: Use parameterized scripts or & operator with validated args. Mark `.breaker-cleared/<file>` if this is intentional (e.g. eval-like DSL).

rules.name: Start-Process with unvalidated args
rules.description: Arguments not validated can lead to command injection.
rules.remediation: Use -ArgumentList with explicit validation. Wrap in ValidateScript.

rules.name: Call operator & with variable command
rules.description: Indirect command execution from variable — injection surface.
rules.remediation: Validate command name against allowlist. Mark `.breaker-cleared/<file>` if necessary.

rules.name: Dynamic code compilation
rules.description: Dynamic script block creation — bypasses AMSI and static analysis.
rules.remediation: Use pre-compiled script blocks. This is almost always a code smell.

rules.name: Dynamic .NET assembly load
rules.description: Loading arbitrary .NET assemblies — privilege escalation vector.
rules.remediation: Pre-compile and reference typed assemblies directly.

rules.name: Add-Type inline C#
rules.description: Inline C# compilation can be abused if source is user-controlled.
rules.remediation: Use pre-compiled types or validate input.

rules.name: COM object instantiation
rules.description: COM objects can enable privilege escalation.
rules.remediation: Validate COM class names against allowlist.

rules.name: Invoke-WebRequest / WebClient to dynamic URL
rules.description: Network call with URL — check for SSRF to internal endpoints (169.254.169.254, localhost).
rules.remediation: Validate URLs against allowlist. Never use user input for URLs.

rules.name: PSDefaultParameterValues redirect
rules.description: Can redirect cmdlet calls (e.g. Invoke-WebRequest) to attacker-controlled proxy.
rules.remediation: Never set PSDefaultParameterValues in shared modules.

rules.name: Secrets in plaintext output
rules.remediation: Use SecureString and masked output. Never log secrets.

rules.name: Unencrypted data export
rules.description: Sensitive data may be written unencrypted.
rules.remediation: Use Export-Clixml -Secure or encrypt at rest.

rules.name: Execution policy bypass
rules.description: Bypassing execution policy weakens security boundary.
rules.remediation: Fix root cause instead of bypassing.

rules.name: AMSI bypass technique
rules.description: AMSI bypass patterns — almost always malicious.
rules.remediation: Remove immediately. This has no legitimate use.

rules.name: Environment variable manipulation (PATH hijack)
rules.description: Modifying PATH or PSModulePath enables hijacking.
rules.remediation: Use fully-qualified paths. Don't modify PATH at runtime.
